```python
def solve(case):
    nodes = case["nodes"]
    required_symbols = set(case["required_symbols"])
    
    # Build lookup structures
    node_by_id = {n["id"]: n for n in nodes}
    children = {n["id"]: [] for n in nodes}
    for n in nodes:
        if n["parent"] is not None:
            children[n["parent"]].append(n["id"])
    
    # Sort nodes: deeper first, then by node ID (lexicographic as stable tiebreak)
    sorted_nodes = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n["depth"], n["id"]))
    
    retained = set(n["id"] for n in nodes)
    removed_order = []
    
    for node in sorted_nodes:
        nid = node["id"]
        
        # Check basic removal conditions
        if not node["removable"]:
            continue
        if node["symbol"] in required_symbols:
            continue
        
        # Check no retained children
        has_retained_children = any(c in retained for c in children[nid])
        if has_retained_children:
            continue
        
        # Check all required symbols still represented after removal
        tentative_retained = retained - {nid}
        symbols_after = set(node_by_id[rid]["symbol"] for rid in tentative_retained)
        if not required_symbols.issubset(symbols_after):
            continue
        
        # Remove the node
        retained = tentative_retained
        removed_order.append(nid)
    
    retained_sorted = sorted(retained)
    
    return {
        "removed_node_ids": removed_order,
        "retained_node_ids": retained_sorted
    }
```
